entities.summary: Theo Upt Hiddema is a Dutch lawyer, media personality and politician who served as a member of the House of Representatives from 2017 to 2020. A former member of Forum for Democracy (FvD), which he left in 2022, he became a member of the Senate in 2021 following the resignation of Nicki Pouw-Verweij, holding a seat until 2023.
